scripts.dev: powershell -Command "$port = if ($env:PORT) { [int]$env:PORT } else { 5000 }; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; nodemon index.js"
